races.name: Supporting Home Run Hounds North West Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Georgemani
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with David Dennis having poor recent form and 81 days off suggests rustiness remains an issue
runners_data.comment: Always behind and pulled up on January's hurdle debut; possibly one for longer term.
runners_data.spotlight: Hinted at ability in his sole start in a point but always behind and pulled up on hurdle/rules debut at Ludlow (2m5f, good to soft) in January; possibly one for further down the line.

runners_data.name: Shantou Premier
runners_data.note: Unknown style and going preference with Christian Williams having moderate 3/14 record creates uncertainty

runners_data.name: Untapped Potential
runners_data.note: Unknown style but strong point-to-point winning margin suggests ability, though Henry Oliver's 0/7 record concerns
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner who looks the type to make an impact over hurdles; one to consider.
runners_data.spotlight: 47,000euros purchase after winning his third start in Irish points by a wide margin (runner-up and third well held since); half-brother to 2m1f/2m5f hurdle winner Major Barry; looks the type to make an impact over hurdles and one to consider on rules debut.

runners_data.name: Yellow Warning
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose Irish point win came on soft ground, just 19 days since unseating at first fence here
runners_data.comment: Irish point winner who was 80-1 when unseating on hurdle debut last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £10,000 after narrowly winning an Irish point (yielding to soft) in October; 80-1 when unseating at the first in a C&D maiden on last month's stable/hurdle debut.

runners_data.name: Neon Dream
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with Alan King's 3/15 record, consistent placed form on good ground makes him reliable each-way option

runners_data.name: Granite Sands
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but 143 days off and disappointing Southwell effort suggests fitness and form concerns
runners_data.comment: Needs to learn to settle, but he could progress if the addition of a hood helps.
runners_data.spotlight: Promising fourth in a Doncaster (2m, good) bumper on debut in March last year; however, he failed to build on that at Southwell (2m, soft) on his return in November, failing to settle and ultimately well held; steps up in trip for this switch to hurdles after another break, with hood added.

runners_data.name: Elusive Pb
runners_data.note: Natural front runner whose Exeter hurdle debut showed promise despite 17-length defeat, tongue-tied both starts
runners_data.comment: Placed in bumpers and confirmed that promise on recent hurdle debut; longer trip may suit.
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in two bumpers on heavy ground and confirmed that promise, albeit beaten 17l, when fifth of 14 on hurdles debut at Exeter (2m, good to soft) last month; needs to prove himself on quicker ground, but his pedigree suggests the step up in trip should suit.

runners_data.name: Ballymoreen
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with £70,000 purchase price reflecting ability, Emma Lavelle's 6/19 record adds trainer confidence
runners_data.comment: Yet to match her Wexford bumper win in two runs over hurdles, but likely to be in the mix.
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish; bought for £70,000 after landing a Wexford bumper in October; improved upon her hurdles/stable debut when a respectable third in a 2m mares' contest here in February, shaping as though this step back up in trip would suit; likely to be involved.

runners_data.name: Sea Of Fortune
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades late, tongue-tied again and failed to complete last two starts raises serious doubts
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in his bumper and got no further that the first on last month's hurdle debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Tongue tied both starts; related to winners but tailed off in a Chepstow bumper on debut and got no further than the first switched to hurdles last month.

runners_data.name: Ample Warning
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but remote seventh at Kempton suggests limited ability despite earlier Ludlow promise
runners_data.comment: Needs to leave behind a disappointing run last time, but she remains open to progress.
runners_data.spotlight: Showed promise switched to hurdles at Ludlow (2m) in December following a lengthy absence, making the frame, but failed to build on that when a remote seventh of 11 at Warwick (2m, good to soft) last month; needs to leave that effort behind, but remains open to progress; stable runs two.

runners_data.name: Lady Blackmore
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner showing gradual improvement over hurdles, though yet to seriously threaten in three attempts
runners_data.comment: Mildly progressive so far over hurdles, but this longer trip could unlock improvement.
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in both Irish points last year and, while yet to make a serious impact in three runs over hurdles (all at 2m), she's been steadily progressing; more is needed, but this longer trip could prompt further improvement; one of two for the stable.

races.paceDynamic: Elusive Pb is the sole confirmed front runner and will be allowed to dictate from the start without pressure. Ballymoreen may track prominently but lacks the natural pace to challenge early, while the majority including Neon Dream, Yellow Warning, and Lady Blackmore prefer to settle off the pace. With only one natural leader in an 11-runner field, Elusive Pb can control the tempo and kick clear when ready. This setup strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and hold-up horses with finishing speed, as the lack of early pace pressure creates a tactical advantage for those positioned to strike late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Elusive Pb gets an easy lead and maintains stamina over the extended trip
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows him to conserve energy and kick clear approaching the last, with his recent Exeter experience proving valuable. His natural front-running style becomes a tactical weapon when unopposed.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the slow early pace sets up a sprint finish from the back
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Neon Dream and Yellow Warning allow them to unleash superior finishing speed in the final half-mile. Alan King's Neon Dream particularly benefits from the tactical setup having shown consistent placed form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Ballymoreen can stay close to Elusive Pb and outstay him late
scenarios.body: The ex-Irish mare's bumper-winning experience and Emma Lavelle's 6/19 strike rate combine with her ability to race prominently. Her stamina reserves prove superior in the final furlong as Elusive Pb begins to tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the established form horses fail to handle the trip or going conditions
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced newcomers Untapped Potential or Shantou Premier benefit from the weak pace and deliver surprise performances. Their point-to-point experience becomes crucial in the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: Sea Of Fortune has failed to complete his last two starts and may not handle the demands of this longer trip
Yellow Warning unseated at the first fence here just 19 days ago and could repeat the error under pressure
Elusive Pb will dictate the pace but his stamina over this extended trip remains unproven beyond 2m distances
Untapped Potential and Shantou Premier are lightly-raced unknowns whose point-to-point form could translate surprisingly well
Neon Dream's consistent placed efforts suggest he will run his race again and provide each-way value at likely odds

races.name: Wye Valley Group Mares' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Jackeline
runners_data.note: Hold-up style suits but only 2 days since last run and trainer's 14-day record is poor at 2/13

runners_data.name: Independent Lady
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with course and distance win last month, Nicky Henderson stable in good form with 4/9 record
runners_data.comment: Won on handicap debut over C&D last month; up 5lb; another bold bid can be expected.
runners_data.spotlight: Left behind her qualifying runs when making a winning handicap debut over C&D (good) last month, asserting in good style from a fair yardstick; 5lb rise looks manageable and another bold bid can be expected.

runners_data.name: Innisfree Pearl
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs strong pace to aim at, promising handicap debut suggests improvement possible
runners_data.comment: Up 2lb but a leading player after a promising start to handicaps over hurdles last month.
runners_data.spotlight: Well held on first two starts over hurdles late last year but, after a respectable fourth back on the Flat (1m6f) in January, made a promising handicap debut over hurdles when keeping on for second at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) last month; 2lb rise looks fair and she is high on the shortlist.

runners_data.name: Ballerina Boxer
runners_data.note: Hold-up style but pulled up on soft ground last time, better on good ground but trainer 0/5 recently
runners_data.comment: Has offered little encouragement in two starts for new stable and easy to look elsewhere.
runners_data.spotlight: 3m Punchestown handicap hurdle winner off a similar mark in June but below that level since; little encouragement in two starts for new yard, pulling up on soft ground then well beaten (46l) at Stratford; has plenty to prove on current evidence.

runners_data.name: Miss Kassiopi
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with decent recent form including two seconds, 42 days since last run could be positive

runners_data.name: Shanagolden Girl
runners_data.note: Prominent racer making handicap debut after three average novice hurdle runs, market support would be significant
runners_data.comment: Could have more to offer now switching to handicaps, with market support worth noting.
runners_data.spotlight: Runner-up in an Irish point; has only hinted at ability in three runs over hurdles (2m-2m3f) but could have more to offer now switching to handicaps and market support would be significant.

runners_data.name: Adaay Dancing
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with settling issues but has shown form that brings her into contention when behaving
runners_data.comment: Has bits of form that bring her into the reckoning but she has stamina to prove.
runners_data.spotlight: Not progressing over hurdles and often undermines her chances by failing to settle, but has bits of form that bring her into the reckoning, notably when fourth at Wincanton (1m7f, good to soft) in February; still something to find and stamina to prove over this longer trip.

runners_data.name: Jessie Jump Jet
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who shaped with promise for new trainer over course and distance, wearing tongue tie and cheekpieces
runners_data.comment: Failed to build on an encouraging stable debut last time; cheekpieces now reached for.
runners_data.spotlight: Failed to progress for previous stable last season and, having shaped with promise over C&D for new stable in January, took a backwards step at Huntingdon (2m4f, good) last month when finishing last of eight; needs the fitting of cheekpieces to get quickly back on track.

races.paceDynamic: Independent Lady will lead from the front with no serious early pressure, as Shanagolden Girl sits prominent but the rest are hold-up horses. This creates a sustainable gallop through the middle sections, allowing Independent Lady to dictate terms without being stressed early. The lack of pace pressure means the front two can save energy for a sustained finish, while the field of hold-up horses will need the leaders to come back to them. This race shape strongly favours the early leaders and prominent racers, as they can control the tempo and have first run when the race develops.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leaders Control Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Lady and Shanagolden Girl maintain their early positions without pressure
scenarios.body: The sustainable pace allows them to kick clear in the straight before the hold-up horses can mount their challenges. Independent Lady's course and distance win last month gives her the edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Challenge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too slow and the race becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace suits the patient hold-up horses who can unleash late runs. Innisfree Pearl and Miss Kassiopi benefit most from a truly-run finish over this staying trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Independent Lady Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Independent Lady gets an uncontested lead and maintains her recent winning form
scenarios.body: She can dictate a pace that suits her perfectly and prove too strong, as she did when winning over course and distance last month. The 5lb rise looks manageable given her improved performance level.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Upset From Outsider
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the tactical nature or settlement issues arise
scenarios.body: Horses with settling problems like Adaay Dancing could benefit from a steadier pace, while Jessie Jump Jet might find improvement for her new stable. The competitive handicap nature allows for surprises.

watchPoints.text: Independent Lady's settling - if she pulls hard early it could compromise her stamina reserves in the closing stages
Shanagolden Girl's market support - any strong money would suggest handicap debut holds more promise than novice form suggests
Adaay Dancing's early settling - her tendency to pull hard often undermines her chances despite having competitive form
Miss Kassiopi's position turning in - she needs to be within striking distance as a hold-up horse to be competitive
Jessie Jump Jet's jumping fluency - any improvement in her hurdling technique could unlock better performance for new stable

races.name: Visit Herefordshire Novices' Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: Graecia
runners_data.note: Hold-up style who has been over-racing recently but has strong claims if settling better, with good form on similar going
runners_data.comment: Below best of late but she's hard to ignore given her second to White Noise in December.
runners_data.spotlight: Has been disappointing of late and can compromise her chances by over-racing, but would have strong claims if back to the form of her Newbury effort (2m, good to soft) in December, namely second to Cheltenham Festival winner White Noise; worth a second look with promising claimer Daire McConville back in the saddle.

runners_data.name: Kingdom Of Stars
runners_data.note: Prominent runner showing improved form, particularly his recent third over 2m4f here representing his best hurdle effort
runners_data.comment: Opening mark is no gift but he remains capable of better in this sphere; interesting.
runners_data.spotlight: Has taken time to come to hand over hurdles but his recent third over 2m4f here last month represented by far his best effort, appreciating the better ground; opening mark is no gift, but he remains capable of better in this sphere; interesting contender.

runners_data.name: Lord Chamberlain
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner whose best effort was third at Ludlow on good to soft, needs to bounce back from poor Huntingdon run
runners_data.comment: Modest effort on latest start but he brings potential switched to handicaps.
runners_data.spotlight: Five-race Flat maiden; clear pick of his three hurdle runs when third of seven at Ludlow (2m, good to soft); needs to leave behind a lesser effort at Huntingdon (2m, good) last time when ridden more prominently, but he brings potential now stepping into handicaps.

runners_data.name: Getaway With You
runners_data.note: Prominent style with solid recent form including three wins in a row before disappointing at Ffos Las
runners_data.comment: Latest run may have come too soon latest, but could resume progress after a short break.
runners_data.spotlight: Won three in a row in November/December (2m3f-2m4f) and scored at Chepstow (2m3f, soft) in February; well-held fourth eight days later at Ffos Las, possibly finding the quick turnaround too much; may resume progress, though the drop in trip is a slight concern.

runners_data.name: Bongo Man
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with consistent place record and good recent second, likely to be finishing strongly

runners_data.name: Bouquet De Paris
runners_data.note: Front runner who will set the pace but may struggle against older rivals despite 4yo weight allowance
runners_data.comment: Better can be expected returned to a more suitable surface, on second start in a handicap.
runners_data.spotlight: Shaped with promise in juvenile hurdles in December, and although his run last month on handicap debut was a shade disappointing, the heavy ground likely counted against him; hood worn the last twice is retained, and a better showing can be expected from this 4yo returned to a more suitable surface.

runners_data.name: Granny B
runners_data.note: Hold-up style returning after 170-day break, winless in 15 hurdle starts but has shown place form previously
runners_data.comment: 15-race maiden who returns on a competitive mark, but with something to prove.
runners_data.spotlight: Yet to win in 15 starts over hurdles, having shown some promising placed efforts last summer before her form dipped in the autumn, and she was last seen finishing lame (well held) at Stratford in October; returns on a competitive mark, but with a bit to prove.

runners_data.name: Desert Halo
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who won last time at soft ground but needs to prove effectiveness on good going

runners_data.name: For Old Times Sake
runners_data.note: Front runner with known tendency to fade, likely to set early pace before weakening
runners_data.comment: Difficult to recommend on recent form, but given his pointing promise, he may do better.
runners_data.spotlight: Has yet to match his Irish point promise in five hurdle races, but did take a step forward on handicap debut in a hood at Huntingdon (2m, heavy) in February before disappointing when a well-backed favourite upped to 2m5f back there the following month (good, hood removed); may do better in time, but difficult to recommend on recent form.

runners_data.name: Now Then Wendy
runners_data.note: Hold-up style veteran who has been consistent recently without threatening to win

runners_data.name: Ramaah
runners_data.note: Prominent runner coming off decent third over course and distance just 12 days ago
runners_data.comment: Produced one of his best efforts when third over C&D last month, but needs more again.
runners_data.spotlight: 1m5f AW Flat winner who has shown only a modest level of ability in a dozen runs over hurdles (2m-2m3f); produced one of his better efforts when third over C&D last month, though beaten 16l; probably place claims at best from out of the weights.

races.paceDynamic: Bouquet De Paris and For Old Times Sake will contest the early lead in this 11-runner field, with Kingdom Of Stars likely tracking close behind from his prominent style. The dual pace angle should create an honest gallop over this sharp 2m trip at Hereford, though For Old Times Sake's tendency to fade in the finish could see Bouquet De Paris taking them along. The sustained pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses like Graecia, Bongo Man and Desert Halo who can finish strongly. This race shape clearly favours the hold-up runners who can benefit from the strong early pace and produce their best work late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace between Bouquet De Paris and For Old Times Sake proves strong enough over 2m
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will perfectly suit the late-running brigade who can pick up the pieces in the final furlong. Graecia, Bongo Man and Desert Halo all possess the tactical speed to capitalize when the leaders tire.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Kingdom Of Stars can secure the ideal position tracking the leaders without getting involved in early pace battles
scenarios.body: His recent improved form and tactical position will allow him to strike when the leaders weaken, getting first run on the hold-up horses. The Kerry Lee runner showed his best effort over 2m4f here last month and drops back in trip with confidence.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Bouquet De Paris can dictate terms without For Old Times Sake providing sustained pressure early
scenarios.body: The Rebecca Curtis runner will get an easier lead than expected and can use his 4yo weight advantage to see off late challengers. His juvenile hurdle form suggests he has more ability than recent handicap debut suggested.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both Bouquet De Paris and For Old Times Sake fail to fire and Kingdom Of Stars doesn't fill the void
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair lacking pace, suiting horses that need time to warm up but can quicken late. This would particularly favor the patient rides on runners returning from breaks.

watchPoints.text: For Old Times Sake's early pace-setting could set up the perfect scenario for hold-up horses if he fades as expected
Kingdom Of Stars needs to avoid getting caught up in any early pace battle between the two confirmed front runners
Graecia's settling will be crucial given her tendency to over-race has compromised recent efforts
Bouquet De Paris may get an uncontested lead if For Old Times Sake doesn't fire, completely changing the race dynamic
The 36-day breaks for both Bouquet De Paris and Getaway With You could impact their fitness levels

races.name: Green Dragon Hotel Hereford Handicap Hurdle

runners_data.name: The Long Walk
runners_data.note: Front-running type with McLernon aboard, 40 days off but showed best recent form at Market Rasen third, drops 2lbs in handicap
runners_data.comment: One bright spot in his four races this autumn/winter; first foray beyond an extended 2m4f
runners_data.spotlight: Third at Market Rasen (extended 2m2f, good to soft) on Boxing Day has been the only bright spot in his four races this autumn/winter; now has a 2lb lower mark and goes beyond an extended 2m4f for the first time.

runners_data.name: Despereaux
runners_data.note: Prominent runner in excellent current form with recent Chepstow win, Jane Williams 0/5 in last 14 days but horse suits conditions perfectly

runners_data.name: Double Click
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer needs strong pace to aim at, 5lb claimer Isabelle Ryder takes off useful weight, has shown best form over similar distances
runners_data.comment: Inconsistent but a better latest effort;  more to prove if ground is not softer than good
runners_data.spotlight: Inconsistent over the last 12 months or so, but second at Exeter in November showed that he stays 2m7f and his best effort since was on latest outing (a rallying third over 2m4f three weeks ago); much more to prove if the ground is not softer than good, but he has to be considered.

runners_data.name: Lelantos
runners_data.note: Prominent racer for Henderson with De Boinville, 50 days since Huntingdon win but proven at this trip and effective on good ground
runners_data.comment: Won at Huntingdon (extended 3m1f) in November; backward steps in his two starts since
runners_data.spotlight: 5-27 over hurdles, the latest win gained at Huntingdon (extended 3m1f, good to soft; 2lb higher today) in November; has a shout on that showing but there have been backward steps in his two starts since.

runners_data.name: Woodythewoodpecker
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been placed twice recently over longer trips at this track, 85 days off but knows the course well
runners_data.comment: 0-10; handicaps on last four starts, on last two occasions runner-up over 3m2f on soft
runners_data.spotlight: Ten-race maiden; sent handicapping for last four starts, on last two occasions finishing runner-up on soft going over 3m2f at this track and Fontwell; different ground is forecast today but he's in serious calculations.

runners_data.name: Malago Rose
runners_data.note: Prominent type with consistent placed efforts this season, 7lb claimer reduces her burden significantly, stays every yard of this trip
runners_data.comment: Creditable minor honours all four starts this term, albeit favourite first three occasions
runners_data.spotlight: 19 races for two wins, the latest in January 2025; creditable minor honours on all four starts this season, albeit as favourite on first three occasions; one of those was under Harriet Tucker; stays 3m2f and will probably be thereabouts.

runners_data.name: The Jam Man
runners_data.note: Veteran prominent runner whose last rules win was 2020, 13-year-old likely outclassed but Potter yard in poor form recently
runners_data.comment: Veteran; has had a 37lb fall in the weights this term but does not persuade
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran whose last win under rules was in 2020 (won a point early in 2024); fourth of 16 at Chepstow in January may look the only positive result in his nine races this season but he was beaten 35l, so that does not persuade; not even with his 37lb fall in the weights this term.

races.paceDynamic: The Long Walk and Despereaux will set a measured gallop from the front with several prominent racers (Lelantos, Malago Rose, The Jam Man) tracking closely behind over this extended 3m1½f trip. The lack of confirmed pace pressure means the leaders can dictate terms, creating a tactical affair where positioning becomes crucial in the straight. Double Click and Woodythewoodpecker must be delivered late from the rear, relying on others to provide the pace injection. This setup strongly favours prominent racers and patient front-runners who can control the tempo and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running Win
scenarios.trigger: If The Long Walk or Despereaux can control the early pace without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The leader dictates a steady tempo before finding extra gear approaching the final hurdle when challenged. This tactical approach perfectly suits horses with the class to quicken off a sound pace rather than needing a strong gallop throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuine but not frantic in the middle stages
scenarios.body: The race develops into a staying test where horses tracking the pace can move smoothly into contention turning for home. Those positioned prominently avoid traffic problems and can time their challenge to perfection when others tire.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Charge
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely strong due to multiple prominent runners going forward
scenarios.body: A truly-run staying test emerges where the patient hold-up horses benefit from the strong gallop ahead of them. Double Click and Woodythewoodpecker can unleash their finishing kicks when others have used their stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Veteran Surprise Package
scenarios.trigger: If the race falls apart tactically with stop-start fractions throughout
scenarios.body: A messy tactical affair where experience trumps raw ability and The Jam Man's veteran racecraft comes to the fore. The 13-year-old can pick his way through a slowly-run contest where others get trapped or commit too early.

watchPoints.text: The Long Walk could steal this if allowed uncontested lead - watch for early pace pressure from Despereaux or prominent trackers
Double Click needs significant pace bias to develop through middle stages - monitor early tempo closely for hold-up chances
Lelantos carrying Henderson stable confidence with De Boinville booking despite 50-day absence - market moves will be telling
Woodythewoodpecker drops back in distance from recent 3m2f efforts - stamina advantage may be reduced over this shorter trip
Both female riders (Ryder and Tucker) claim significant weight - watch for confident riding from the front if apprentices get early position

races.name: We Are Farming Minds Charity Partner Mares' Handicap Chase (Challenger Mares' Chase Qualifier) (GBB)

runners_data.name: That's Nice
runners_data.note: Prominent racer from powerful Henderson yard with 4/9 recent strike-rate, but transition to fences has been inconsistent despite 38 days to prepare
runners_data.comment: Won Irish point; 2-3 in novice hurdles; shaky switch to fences; had wind op since latest
runners_data.spotlight: Won sole Irish point and two of three novice hurdles (both 2m3f, good to soft); shaky transition to fences but she jumped soundly in a five-runner Newbury race in February before stopping to nothing under pressure; wind surgery since could have helped; retains potential.

runners_data.name: Malaita
runners_data.note: Natural front runner carrying just 155lbs, first-time tongue-tie fitted and trainer Mel Rowley struggling with 0/10 recent record
runners_data.comment: Had a difficult winter but return to 2m4f on good ground can suit; cheekpieces added
runners_data.spotlight: Two chase wins at about 2m4f in early 2024 (soft and good); has not found life easy this winter but 3m found her out on her latest start (first-time tongue-tie; cheekpieces now added) and the return to shorter on good ground should suit; bold bid likely.

runners_data.name: Party Vibes
runners_data.note: Prominent type who excels on good ground but Henry Daly's 0/8 recent form is concerning, needs to bounce back from heavy ground failure
runners_data.comment: Both chase wins on good to soft; has struggled on heavy and soft of late; possible reviver
runners_data.spotlight: Hurdle winner on soft but two chase wins in 2025 were on good to soft, latterly at Cheltenham (about 2m4f) in December, and failures since have come on heavy and soft; needs to jump better than she did at Ludlow in February (over 17l behind Malaita) but she could revive back on good ground.

runners_data.name: Belle Montrose
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with recent wins but faces tactical disadvantage in small field, first-time tongue-tie and 20lb weight pull helps

races.paceDynamic: Malaita will take the field along as the sole confirmed front runner, with That's Nice and Party Vibes likely tracking in second and third positions respectively. With only four runners and one clear pace-setter, Malaita can dictate at a sustainable gallop without pressure through the early stages over this 2m5f trip. Belle Montrose will settle at the rear as a hold-up performer, relying on her finishing kick. This uncontested lead scenario strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Malaita Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Malaita maintains a steady gallop and jumps cleanly from the front
scenarios.body: The 10-year-old can use her experience to dictate terms without pressure, making full use of her 13lb weight advantage over the field. Her two wins at similar distances in early 2024 show she can be effective when allowed to bowl along in front.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If That's Nice or Party Vibes can track Malaita closely and strike approaching the final fence
scenarios.body: Both Henderson and Daly runners have the class edge on ratings and can benefit from a tow into the race before utilizing superior finishing speed. The good ground particularly suits Party Vibes who struggled on heavy at Ascot last time.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Belle Montrose Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes truly sedate and Belle Montrose gets a clear run from the back
scenarios.body: The 7-year-old's hold-up style could prove effective if she can weave through traffic and unleash her finishing kick. Her recent wins show she has the ability when things fall right.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.body: Any significant jumping error from the front runner could hand the initiative to the prominent racers who are well-placed to capitalize. The small field means any mistake is magnified in importance.

runners_data.spotlight: Showed staying promise over fences earlier in career but he's been in moderate form since back from an absence, pulling up on last two starts.

races.paceDynamic: Jukebox d'Eddy will control this race from the front without pressure, creating a sustainable galloping pace throughout the 3m1f trip. With four hold-up horses behind him (Edgewell, Walkinthewoods, Braganza Bay, Meranti), the leader can dictate terms and kick for home when ready. The lack of pace pressure means those tracking will need to time their challenges perfectly from off the pace. This race shape strongly favours the front runner and any prominent racers who can travel easily in behind, as the hold-up horses will face a tactical disadvantage with limited early pace to aim at.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Jukebox Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Jukebox d'Eddy maintains his sustainable lead without serious pressure until the home turn.
scenarios.body: The leader can quicken at his chosen moment while the hold-up brigade struggle to close from too far back. His recent good form and front-running style perfectly suits this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Challenge Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If one of the hold-up horses produces a strong finishing kick despite the tactical disadvantage.
scenarios.body: Edgewell or Braganza Bay times their run to perfection, using superior class or fitness to reel in Jukebox d'Eddy in the final furlong. The front runner pays for controlling the race.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Develops
scenarios.trigger: If the genuine pace over 3m1f becomes a true staying test in the closing stages.
scenarios.body: Jukebox d'Eddy's stamina reserves prove decisive while others tire from their efforts to close the gap. The distance sorts out the genuine stayers from the rest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Jukebox d'Eddy goes too slowly and allows the field to bunch up turning for home.
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class and tactical position matter most, allowing a hold-up horse with the right position to strike. Braganza Bay's course record becomes crucial.

watchPoints.text: Jukebox d'Eddy builds an unassailable lead as the hold-up horses give him too much rope in the early stages.
Edgewell gets too far back early and relies on his finishing kick against the tactical tide of this race shape.
Walkinthewoods shows signs of stopping beyond 2m4f as his stamina limitations become apparent in the closing stages.
Braganza Bay jumps fluently on his return to fences after his recent hurdles campaign with Henry Daly.
The pace becomes pedestrian through the middle sections allowing the field to bunch up approaching the home turn.
